package rulefixtures

// scenario for unbuffered_channel_for_known_producer_count: unbuffered channels `make(chan T)` when the number of producers/messages is known at construction time
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Result struct{ Value int }

func scenario690Positive(ids []int) []Result {
	const numWorkers = 8
	ch := make(chan Result)
	for i := 0; i < numWorkers; i++ {
		go func(id int) {
			ch <- Result{Value: id * 2}
		}(ids[i])
	}
	var results []Result
	for i := 0; i < numWorkers; i++ {
		results = append(results, <-ch)
	}
	return results
}
